title: Omuzimbi w’Ebiziyiza
intro: Mu nsi ennene ennyo, omuntu ow’amaanyi ennyo yatandikawo entambula eziwerako, n’aweebwa obuyinza n’obusobozi obw’ekitalo. Omwoyo guno gwasisinkana ebitundu eby’enjawulo era ne gusanga okusoomoozebwa okw’enjawulo, ne guleka akabonero akawangaala ku byafaayo n’okukkiriza okuyita mu bikolwa byabwe n’amagezi gaabwe, byonna nga bikkiriza ensibuko entuufu ey’amaanyi gaabwe.
clues: Naweebwa obuyinza n’obusobozi ku buli kimu, era ne ngoberera ekkubo.
Olugendo lwange lwantwala mu kifo enjuba we yagwa, gye nnasanga abantu.
Nasanga ekitundu ekyali tekisobola bulungi kutegeera kwogera, nga kibeera wakati w’ensozi bbiri.
Nnasabibwa okuzimba ekiziyiza, si lwa kwefunira, wabula okukuuma amaanyi agazikiriza.
Nalangirira nti amaanyi ag’okuzimba bbugwe ono omunene ennyo gava eri Allah, era ajja kuyimirira okutuusa ekiseera ekyasuubizibwa.
Erinnya lyange, eritera okuvvuunulwa nga ‘Oyo ow’amayembe abiri,’ litegeeza okutuuka kwange okubuna ensi oba oboolyawo emirembe ebiri egy’enjawulo.
arabic: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّى فِيهِ رَبِّى خَيْرٌۭ فَأَعِينُونِى بِقُوَّةٍ أَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا
verse: He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength [i.e., manpower]; I will make between you and them a dam. (18:95)
